title: Capital allocation
learning_outcomes: Explain opportunity cost in the context of capital allocation.
Compare and distinguish risk-adjusted options in the context of capital allocation.
Apply liquidity in the context of capital allocation.
Evaluate and justify decisions about allocation principles in the context of capital allocation.

lessons.title: Opportunity cost
lessons.outcome: Explain opportunity cost in the context of capital allocation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving opportunity cost; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to capital allocation memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain opportunity cost from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of opportunity cost; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Risk-adjusted options
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish risk-adjusted options in the context of capital allocation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving risk-adjusted options; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to capital allocation memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain risk-adjusted options from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of risk-adjusted options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Liquidity
lessons.outcome: Apply liquidity in the context of capital allocation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving liquidity; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to capital allocation memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain liquidity from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of liquidity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Allocation principles
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about allocation principles in the context of capital allocation.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving allocation principles; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to capital allocation memo.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain allocation principles from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of allocation principles; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of opportunity cost; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of risk-adjusted options; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of liquidity; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of allocation principles; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
